title: ci: only push bin image from upstream repository
body: ## Summary Change the `bin-image.yml` action to only push when the target repository is `moby/moby`; preventing CI failures in forks. This is similar to https://github.com/moby/moby/blob/8bc88f10b9be3086d85fb1f8f515fd1c39f03fc4/.github/workflows/ci.yml#L156 ## Release notes (optional) ```markdown changelog ``` ## A picture of a cute animal (not mandatory but encouraged)
